description: {"time": 1783112260806, "blocks": [{"id": "jhqjcmn3wo", "data": {"text": "Ooops \u2014 an Ongata Line Sacco matatu that wore its humour on its panels. The exclamatory name captures the everyday 'oops' moments of Nairobi commuting: a sudden brake, a missed stop, a fare negotiation gone wrong. Dennis Muraguri's 2019 woodcut captures the playful lettering and the matatu's distinctive graphic details. There is a warmth to Ooops that distinguishes it from more aggressive matatu names. It suggests a driver with a sense of humour, a vehicle that didn't take itself too seriously despite dominating the Ongata Rongai route. Muraguri's practice of working directly from observed matatus means every detail \u2014 the font choice, the layout, the proportions \u2014 is authentic to the original. This A3 landscape print adds a touch of Nairobi humour to any wall.
